    (hcells : ∀ j < n,

    (hv : ∀ j < n, 0 ≤ v j) (hw : ∀ j < n, 0 ≤ w j)
    (hvbound : ∀ j < n, (v j : ℝ) / Q ≤ wuImprovementLimit upper δ (x (j+1)))

      ∫ u in x 0..x n, wuImprovementLimit upper δ u / u :=
